This report preprocesses each data source separately. It does not read the band-data SAV file, aggregate EMA observations to days, construct
new focal-variable scales, or merge baseline, daily-diary, and EMA data. All
source variables are retained so focal-variable selection can be made from the
clean RDA objects in the next stage.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  collapse = FALSE,
  comment = NA
)

required_packages <- c("bruceR", "dplyr", "haven", "jsonlite", "knitr", "readxl", "rmarkdown")
package_available <- vapply(required_packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)
if (!all(package_available)) {
  stop("Missing required R packages: ", paste(names(package_available)[!package_available], collapse = ", "))
}

locate_project_root <- function(start = getwd()) {
  candidates <- unique(normalizePath(c(start, file.path(start, "..")), winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE))
  hits <- candidates[
    dir.exists(file.path(candidates, "Step_1_Descriptive_and_Reliability")) &
      dir.exists(file.path(candidates, "Step_2_Measurement_Models"))
  ]
  if (length(hits) != 1L) {
    stop("Could not identify a unique analysis project root from: ", start)
  }
  hits[[1L]]
}

project_root <- locate_project_root()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = project_root)

raw_dir <- file.path(project_root, "Res_1_PreprocessedData")
out_dir <- file.path(project_root, "Res_2_Data_for_Analysis")
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

baseline_file <- file.path(raw_dir, "DD_Baseline_209_0604.sav")
daily_file <- file.path(raw_dir, "data_daily correct997-6041.sav")
ema_file <- file.path(raw_dir, "data_ema correct997-6041.sav")
tracker_file <- file.path(raw_dir, "tracker.xlsx")
correction_file <- Sys.getenv(
  "PSMU_PRIVATE_CORRECTIONS",
  unset = file.path(out_dir, "private_baseline_corrections.json")
)
if (!file.exists(correction_file)) {
  stop("Raw-source preprocessing requires a private correction file. ",
       "Use the prepared, de-identified entry data for public reproduction.")
}
private_corrections <- jsonlite::fromJSON(correction_file)
if (!identical(private_corrections$schema_version, 1L)) {
  stop("Unsupported private correction schema.")
}

input_files <- c(baseline_file, daily_file, ema_file, tracker_file)
if (!all(file.exists(input_files))) {
  stop("Missing required input files: ", paste(input_files[!file.exists(input_files)], collapse = ", "))
}
```

# Helper functions

```{r helpers}
apply_private_baseline_corrections <- function(data, specification, phase) {
  stopifnot(phase %in% c("name", "age"), all(c("Name_ID", "Name") %in% names(data)))
  rules <- specification[[paste0(phase, "_corrections")]]
  required <- if (phase == "name") c("id", "value") else c("id", "match_name", "value")
  if (!is.data.frame(rules) || !all(required %in% names(rules)) ||
      anyNA(rules[required]) || anyDuplicated(rules$id)) {
    stop("Invalid private correction specification.")
  }
  if (phase == "age" && (!"AgeInYears" %in% names(data) ||
      !is.numeric(rules$value) || any(!is.finite(rules$value)))) {
    stop("Invalid age-correction input.")
  }
  for (index in seq_len(nrow(rules))) {
    matched <- data$Name_ID == rules$id[[index]]
    if (phase == "name") {
      data$Name <- dplyr::if_else(matched, rules$value[[index]], data$Name)
    } else {
      matched <- matched | data$Name == rules$match_name[[index]]
      data$AgeInYears <- dplyr::if_else(matched, rules$value[[index]], data$AgeInYears)
    }
  }
  data
}

recode_missing_999 <- function(data, missing_code = -999) {
  data[] <- lapply(data, function(x) {
    if (is.numeric(x)) {
      x[x == missing_code] <- NA
    }
    x
  })
  data
}

as_plain_numeric <- function(x) {
  if (!haven::is.labelled(x)) return(x)
  variable_label <- attr(x, "label", exact = TRUE)
  out <- as.numeric(x)
  if (!is.null(variable_label)) attr(out, "label") <- variable_label
  out
}

duplicate_key_summary <- function(data, keys) {
  duplicate_groups <- data |>
    dplyr::count(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(keys)), name = "n") |>
    dplyr::filter(n > 1L)
  data.frame(
    key = paste(keys, collapse = " + "),
    duplicate_groups = nrow(duplicate_groups),
    rows_in_duplicate_groups = sum(duplicate_groups$n),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

source_summary <- function(raw, clean, id_var, level) {
  data.frame(
    level = level,
    raw_rows = nrow(raw),
    raw_columns = ncol(raw),
    clean_rows = nrow(clean),
    clean_columns = ncol(clean),
    participants = dplyr::n_distinct(clean[[id_var]]),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}
```

# Read source files

All SAV files are read with `bruceR::import()`. Raw objects are retained in memory only for audit comparisons and
are not saved to the output directory.

```{r import}
dat_baseline_raw <- bruceR::import(baseline_file)
dat_daily_raw <- bruceR::import(daily_file)
dat_ema_raw <- bruceR::import(ema_file)
tracker_raw <- bruceR::import(tracker_file)

data.frame(
  source = c("baseline", "daily", "EMA", "tracker"),
  rows = c(nrow(dat_baseline_raw), nrow(dat_daily_raw), nrow(dat_ema_raw), nrow(tracker_raw)),
  columns = c(ncol(dat_baseline_raw), ncol(dat_daily_raw), ncol(dat_ema_raw), ncol(tracker_raw))
) |>
  knitr::kable(
    format = "html",
    caption = "Import",
    row.names = FALSE,
    escape = TRUE,
    table.attr = 'class="table table-striped table-condensed"'
  )
```

# Baseline preprocessing

All 405 baseline variables are retained. `pid` is renamed to `Name_ID`.
Labelled demographic variables are converted to factors so their category
labels remain interpretable; labelled scale/item variables are converted to
plain numeric columns. The tracker is used only to derive questionnaire end
date and analytic age within the baseline object.

```{r baseline-clean}
baseline_demographic_vars <- intersect(
  c(
    "Gender", "School", "Grade", "Ethnicity", "FamilyResidence",
    "ParentsMaritalStatus", "ParentsHighestEdu", "TotalFamilyIncome",
    "SilbingStructure", "NumOfChildsInFamliy", "PaternalEducation",
    "PaternalOccupation", "MaternalEducation", "MaternalOccupation"
  ),
  names(dat_baseline_raw)
)
baseline_demographic_vars[baseline_demographic_vars == "SilbingStructure"] <- "SiblingStructure"

dat_baseline <- recode_missing_999(dat_baseline_raw) |>
  dplyr::rename(Name_ID = pid, SiblingStructure = SilbingStructure) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(baseline_demographic_vars), ~ {
      if (haven::is.labelled(.x)) haven::as_factor(.x) else .x
    }),
    dplyr::across(
      -dplyr::all_of(c("Name_ID", "Name", "DateOfBirth", baseline_demographic_vars)),
      as_plain_numeric
    ),
    Name_ID = as.numeric(Name_ID),
    Name = as.character(Name),
    DateOfBirth = as.Date(DateOfBirth)
  )

# Identifying correction values are supplied privately, never embedded in source.
dat_baseline <- apply_private_baseline_corrections(
  dat_baseline, private_corrections, phase = "name"
)

tracker <- tracker_raw |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    Tracker_ID = as.character(编号),
    Name = as.character(姓名),
    QuestionnaireStartDate = as.Date(问卷开始日期),
    QuestionnaireEndDate = as.Date(问卷结束日期)
  )

if (anyDuplicated(tracker$Name)) {
  stop("Tracker participant names are not unique; audit before deriving age.")
}

dat_baseline <- dat_baseline |>
  dplyr::left_join(tracker, by = "Name") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    AgeInDays = as.numeric(QuestionnaireEndDate - DateOfBirth),
    AgeInYears = AgeInDays / 365.25
  )
dat_baseline <- apply_private_baseline_corrections(
  dat_baseline, private_corrections, phase = "age"
) |>
  dplyr::arrange(Name_ID)
```

## Baseline audit

```{r baseline-audit}
baseline_duplicates <- duplicate_key_summary(dat_baseline, "Name_ID")
baseline_unmatched_tracker <- dat_baseline |>
  dplyr::filter(is.na(QuestionnaireEndDate)) |>
  dplyr::select(Name_ID, Name)

baseline_duplicates |>
  knitr::kable(
    format = "html",
    caption = "Baseline audit",
    row.names = FALSE,
    escape = TRUE,
    table.attr = 'class="table table-striped table-condensed"'
  )
baseline_unmatched_tracker |>
  knitr::kable(
    format = "html",
    caption = "Baseline audit (2)",
    row.names = FALSE,
    escape = TRUE,
    table.attr = 'class="table table-striped table-condensed"'
  )

dat_baseline |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    participants = dplyr::n_distinct(Name_ID),
    missing_id = sum(is.na(Name_ID)),
    missing_age = sum(is.na(AgeInYears)),
    minimum_age = min(AgeInYears, na.rm = TRUE),
    maximum_age = max(AgeInYears, na.rm = TRUE),
    age_below_18 = sum(AgeInYears < 18, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  knitr::kable(
    format = "html",
    caption = "Baseline audit (3)",
    row.names = FALSE,
    escape = TRUE,
    table.attr = 'class="table table-striped table-condensed"'
  )
```

# Daily-diary preprocessing

The daily data remain at person-day level. All columns are retained, `-999` is
converted to `NA`, labelled numeric columns are converted to plain numeric, and
the existing source-derived variables are preserved without recalculation.

```{r daily-clean}
dat_daily <- recode_missing_999(dat_daily_raw)
dat_daily[] <- lapply(dat_daily, as_plain_numeric)
dat_daily <- dat_daily |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Data_ID = as.numeric(Data_ID),
    Name_ID = as.numeric(Name_ID),
    Day = as.integer(Day)
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(Name_ID, Day)

daily_duplicates <- duplicate_key_summary(dat_daily, c("Name_ID", "Day"))
daily_duplicates |>
  knitr::kable(
    format = "html",
    caption = "Daily clean",
    row.names = FALSE,
    escape = TRUE,
    table.attr = 'class="table table-striped table-condensed"'
  )

dat_daily |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    participants = dplyr::n_distinct(Name_ID),
    person_days = dplyr::n(),
    minimum_day = min(Day, na.rm = TRUE),
    maximum_day = max(Day, na.rm = TRUE),
    missing_id = sum(is.na(Name_ID)),
    missing_day = sum(is.na(Day))
  ) |>
  knitr::kable(
    format = "html",
    caption = "Daily clean (2)",
    row.names = FALSE,
    escape = TRUE,
    table.attr = 'class="table table-striped table-condensed"'
  )
```

# EMA preprocessing

The EMA data remain at prompt level. All columns are retained, `-999` is
converted to `NA`, and labelled numeric columns are converted to plain numeric.
No daily aggregation or new scale construction is performed.

```{r ema-clean}
dat_ema <- recode_missing_999(dat_ema_raw)
dat_ema[] <- lapply(dat_ema, as_plain_numeric)
dat_ema <- dat_ema |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Data_ID = as.numeric(Data_ID),
    Name_ID = as.numeric(Name_ID),
    Day = as.integer(Day),
    Time = as.integer(Time)
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(Name_ID, Day, Time)

ema_prompt_duplicates <- duplicate_key_summary(dat_ema, c("Name_ID", "Day", "Time"))
ema_prompt_duplicates |>
  knitr::kable(
    format = "html",
    caption = "Ema clean",
    row.names = FALSE,
    escape = TRUE,
    table.attr = 'class="table table-striped table-condensed"'
  )

dat_ema |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    participants = dplyr::n_distinct(Name_ID),
    prompts = dplyr::n(),
    person_days = dplyr::n_distinct(paste(Name_ID, Day)),
    minimum_day = min(Day, na.rm = TRUE),
    maximum_day = max(Day, na.rm = TRUE),
    minimum_time = min(Time, na.rm = TRUE),
    maximum_time = max(Time, na.rm = TRUE),
    missing_id = sum(is.na(Name_ID)),
    missing_day = sum(is.na(Day)),
    missing_time = sum(is.na(Time))
  ) |>
  knitr::kable(
    format = "html",
    caption = "Ema clean (2)",
    row.names = FALSE,
    escape = TRUE,
    table.attr = 'class="table table-striped table-condensed"'
  )
```

# Cross-source ID audit without merging

This comparison does not combine rows or columns. It only checks whether the
three independently cleaned sources contain the same participant IDs.

```{r id-audit}
id_sets <- list(
  baseline = sort(unique(dat_baseline$Name_ID)),
  daily = sort(unique(dat_daily$Name_ID)),
  EMA = sort(unique(dat_ema$Name_ID))
)

id_audit <- list(
  baseline_not_daily = setdiff(id_sets$baseline, id_sets$daily),
  daily_not_baseline = setdiff(id_sets$daily, id_sets$baseline),
  EMA_not_daily = setdiff(id_sets$EMA, id_sets$daily),
  daily_not_EMA = setdiff(id_sets$daily, id_sets$EMA)
)

data.frame(
  comparison = names(id_audit),
  unmatched_count = lengths(id_audit),
  unmatched_ids = vapply(id_audit, function(ids) paste(ids, collapse = ", "), character(1)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) |>
  knitr::kable(
    format = "html",
    caption = "Id audit",
    row.names = FALSE,
    escape = TRUE,
    table.attr = 'class="table table-striped table-condensed"'
  )
```

# Save clean component RDA files

Each source is saved separately for focused inspection. A combined RDA file is
also provided for convenience; it contains three separate R objects and does
not contain a merged data frame.

```{r validate-and-save}
stopifnot(
  baseline_duplicates$duplicate_groups == 0L,
  daily_duplicates$duplicate_groups == 0L,
  ema_prompt_duplicates$duplicate_groups == 0L,
  !anyNA(dat_baseline$Name_ID),
  !anyNA(dat_daily[c("Name_ID", "Day")]),
  !anyNA(dat_ema[c("Name_ID", "Day", "Time")])
)

baseline_output <- file.path(out_dir, "dat_baseline_clean.rda")
daily_output <- file.path(out_dir, "dat_daily_clean.rda")
ema_output <- file.path(out_dir, "dat_ema_clean.rda")
components_output <- file.path(out_dir, "dat_clean_components.rda")

if (isTRUE(params$write_artifacts)) {
  save(dat_baseline, file = baseline_output, compress = "xz")
  save(dat_daily, file = daily_output, compress = "xz")
  save(dat_ema, file = ema_output, compress = "xz")
  save(dat_baseline, dat_daily, dat_ema, file = components_output, compress = "xz")
}

output_manifest <- data.frame(
  file = normalizePath(
    c(baseline_output, daily_output, ema_output, components_output),
    winslash = "/",
    mustWork = TRUE
  ),
  objects = c("dat_baseline", "dat_daily", "dat_ema", "dat_baseline; dat_daily; dat_ema"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
output_manifest$bytes <- file.info(output_manifest$file)$size
output_manifest |>
  knitr::kable(
    format = "html",
    caption = "Validate and save",
    row.names = FALSE,
    escape = TRUE,
    table.attr = 'class="table table-striped table-condensed"'
  )
```
